author: John Carbutt (1832-1905)

locator: The left half of the stereo card: the Chamber of Commerce from the north-west, across Washington Street from the Court House square's south-west corner, its Washington Street front (five bays, two, one, two) at left and its long LaSalle Street side receding to the right; the Court House square's iron fence in the foreground at left, a brick hotel with a mansard behind at far left.
rights_note: A photograph published before 1872; public domain in the United States. Commons carries the file under its PD-US / PD-scan declaration.

note: The one photograph found of the 1865 building's two street fronts together. It shows the banded rustication over the whole wall, the corner piers, the triple-arched entrance in the projecting centre bay, the tall round-arched windows of the exchange room in the upper storey, the bracketed cornice, and the curved mansard with oval dormers in front and small dormers along the side; at street level on LaSalle the shop fronts under the ground storey's paired arched windows. Monochrome.
what_it_supplies: the massing, storeys and bay rhythm of the Washington and LaSalle fronts
the mansard, its dormers and the centre bay's clock pediment
the street-level shop fronts on LaSalle Street
